body:
Review pass 42. Epic 9 claimed - here is the whole checklist against the current tree, so you have it in one place rather than across seven beads.

MET, verified this pass:
  Print/format/coercion - 26 S3method entries where my first review counted ZERO. as_neurovol() round-trips exactly on a masked volume, spacing preserved, correct NA fill.
  README opens with the fMRI problem - "estimate where experimental effects are reproducible, how their multivariate geometry changes across the brain, and which local patterns generalize across independent runs". That was my original complaint and it is fixed.
  Product-oracle resolution - the two package-free contract files that tested oracle-against-oracle are gone, and the independent oracle helpers survive (effect-form-laws, evidence-pairing-laws, measurement-form-oracle, plus a new residual-statistics helper). Exactly what I asked for.
  Suite green - 1819 pass, 0 fail, 0 error, 0 warn.

GAPS against your own criteria:
  NEW bd-01KZY2DW2XHE207JMFPVEV957W - "runnable Rd examples cover the first user journey". 5 of 82 Rd files have examples, and they are crossnobis/plan_crossnobis/plan_geometry/neural_metric/metric_components - the Epic 5-7 surface. The first journey is relation -> compile_frame(searchlights) -> geometry -> contrast/rdm/rsa -> as_neurovol, and NONE of those nine has an example. Small job: the README already contains a runnable sequence for exactly those functions.
  bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8 - "slower tiers run" but nothing sets EFFECTAGRAM_RUN_SCALE_TESTS.
  bd-01KZY1YJ426SEKJM6Q4THDAR7J - R CMD check not run in 10708 lines / 43 new man pages.
  bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED - certified artifact still has no commit; 20 untracked R files.
  bd-01KZXWPKT4XPSB55PB5RBSAZRT - the passing gate certifies performance on a fixture where 84% of supports have k > residual df. 1677 s of headroom makes a meaningful re-run cheap.
  bd-01KZXW5MFZGEXVJ3CMKMGBGFZX - MC variance gate at 1% headroom.

ORDERING MATTERS FOR TWO OF THESE: add the Rd examples BEFORE running R CMD check. Examples are executed by the check, so the reverse order means certifying a check and then enlarging its surface.
